# CallDirector AI

> CallDirector AI (CallDirector AI, LLC) builds and manages AI receptionist, lead follow-up and booking systems for service businesses in Washington DC, Maryland and Virginia. Vera, the AI receptionist, answers calls 24/7, collects and reads back caller details, alerts the team, transfers urgent calls and starts follow-up. Founded by Rodrigue Dossouvi, a phone-system engineer with more than 22 years in telecom.

## Contact

- Main line: (844) 727-8090 (calls and texts)
- Live AI receptionist demo line: (240) 852-1600 (call it to hear Vera answer)
- Email: hello@calldirector.ai
- Service area: Washington DC, Maryland and Virginia
- Languages: English, Spanish, French and more
- Free Lead Leak Audit (private one-page report within 48 hours): https://calldirector.ai/audit/

## Plans and pricing

All plans are month-to-month with 30 days' notice to cancel. No long-term contract.

- [Vera Front Desk](https://calldirector.ai/vera/): $197/month + $299 one-time setup. 200 AI call minutes and 500 texts a month. 24/7 call answering, caller details read back, call recording with summary and rating, text and email alerts, urgent calls transferred to a person.
- [Vera + Follow-Up](https://calldirector.ai/pricing/): $347/month + $499 one-time setup. 500 AI call minutes and 1,000 texts a month. Adds missed-call text back, new-lead SMS and email follow-up, booking links by text, review requests and a monthly results report.
- [AI Growth System](https://calldirector.ai/ai-growth-system/): from $497/month + implementation from $2,500, scoped to the business. 750 AI call minutes and 1,500 texts a month. Adds an AI-powered website and landing pages, AI web chat, CRM automation and booking, estimate follow-up, customer reactivation, hosting and ongoing optimization. Founding offer: $1,500 implementation for the first 5 qualified DMV businesses.
- Usage over the allowance: $0.40 to $0.45 per extra minute, $0.05 per extra text, with a usage report.
- Vera Front Desk and Vera + Follow-Up go live within 5 business days of getting what we need from the business, or the setup fee is refunded.
